text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text: No way! It's gotten even stronger?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな！　
まだ強くなるんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, come on!
I thought we were in for an easy ride!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
聞いてないよー！
もっと楽に倒せると思ったのにー！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Battles are always a struggle...
Still, a challenge makes things more interesting, so I'm all for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽な戦いなんてないってことかな……
歯ごたえがある方が面白いし、
私としては大歓迎。

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text: If only you could lend us some of that enthusiasm, Shiburin...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しぶりんのそのやる気を
私たちにも分けてほしいよ……
